integrity: Two standalone exact-arithmetic verifiers are included. Scientific claims and computational statements refer only to these package files. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact coefficient-marked two-parameter characteristic-seven family on the discriminant-open locus only; no geometric-isomorphism quotient, complete Newton polygon or full Ekedahl–Oort classification. The F7 census corroborates, but does not prove, the all-geometric-parameter statement. An unindexed earlier specialization remains a residual originality risk.
title: Five \(7\)-rank strata in a genus-six cyclic-quartic family
